svg.title: Spec lifecycle
svg.desc: A feature spec goes draft, planned, in-progress, done, one command per step. When verify finds gaps, approving the fixes sends the spec to approved and plan adds an amendment; declining blocks it until plan resumes it or it is dropped; a spec change sends it back to draft for specify, then plan.

g.text: Each command is your approval of the step before it.
VERIFY FINDS GAPS, YOU APPROVE THE FIXES
Plan adds them as an amendment, and the loop runs again.
VERIFY FINDS GAPS, YOU DECLINE THE FIXES
The spec is blocked until you plan them after all, or drop it by hand.
A FIX CHANGES THE SPEC ITSELF
Back to draft: revise it with specify, then plan the rest.
